blocks.text: Standard hydrogen electrode un kai qism ke half-cells mein se ek hai jo reference electrode ke taur par istemal ho sakte hain (Figure 10.4). Is mein 101 kPa dabao par hydrogen gas hai jo 1.00 mol dm-3 concentration ke H+ ions ke saath equilibrium mein hai, aur platinum black se dhaka platinum electrode jo hydrogen gas aur H+ ions ke rabte mein hai. Platinum black bareek pisa platinum hai, jo hydrogen gas aur H+ ions ka qareebi rabta deta hai taake H2 gas aur H+ ions ke darmiyan equilibrium jaldi qaim ho; platinum electrode inert hai aur reaction mein hissa nahi leta. Sab half-cells ki standard electrode potential qeematein is electrode ke muqable napi jati hain: jab yeh kisi doosre half-cell se jora jaye to voltmeter ki reading us half-cell ka standard electrode potential deti hai.

blocks.alt: Shishe ki tube 298 K par 1 mol dm-3 H+ mahlool ke beaker mein dubi hai. 1 atm par hydrogen gas side arm se dakhil ho kar platinum black wale platinum electrode ke gird shishe ki ghanti ke surakhon se bulbulon mein nikalti hai; electrode platinum taar se juda hai. Dabbe mein 2H+ + 2e- = H2, E standard = 0.00 V, yaani reference electrode.
blocks.caption: Standard hydrogen electrode (SHE) (Figure 10.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Hydrogen electrode ki half-equation 2H+(aq) + 2e- se H2(g), E standard = 0.00 V, ya barabar H+(aq) + e- se 1/2 H2(g), E standard = 0.00 V hai. Half-equation ko balance karne ka tareeqa E standard par koi farq nahi dalta, kyunke muadla element ke electrons hasil karne ke rujhan par asar nahi karta; us ka voltage ikhtiyari taur par 0.00 V muqarrar hai.

blocks.prompt: SHE kya hai aur doosre electrode ka electrode potential napne mein kaise istemal hota hai (exercise Q.6)?
blocks.explanation: Yeh platinum black electrode hai jo 101 kPa par hydrogen mein nahaya aur 1.00 mol dm-3 H+ mein dooba hai, jis ka half-reaction 0.00 V muqarrar hai. Napa jane wala half-cell us se high-resistance voltmeter wale taar aur salt bridge se jora jata hai; voltmeter ki reading, apne nishan ke saath jo batata hai kaun sa electrode musbat hai, us half-cell ka standard electrode potential hai.

items: SHE: 1.00 mol dm-3 H+ mein platinum black par 101 kPa par H2; 2H+ + 2e- = H2 0.00 V muqarrar; inert Pt; sab E standard qeematein is ke muqable; half-equation ka balance E nahi badalta.
